name: drive-sentinel
description: Inspect fixed and removable drives before cleanup. Drive Sentinel keeps scans explicit, measures live disk usage, separates cloud-backed files from local bytes, and refuses unsafe unattended cleanup.
author: Codex Crew
highlights: Selection measures the live volume without starting an automatic scan
Cleanup stays locked until the selected drive and indexed root agree
Unattended cleanup is restricted to safe system-drive cache targets
Cloud-backed roots remain measure-only unless the provider supports a safe operation
useCases: Find what is consuming a local drive before deciding whether to clean it.
Review safe, rebuildable cache targets separately from report-only data.
Monitor free space while keeping removable and cloud-backed storage explicit.
configuration: Drive Sentinel accepts app requests only through Codex Crew's authenticated local proxy.
Scanning and cleanup are separate actions. A stale or mismatched index cannot unlock cleanup.
Audit records stay under the configured Codex Crew data home, never inside the installed package.
